definitions.explanation: Something that is sharp, clear, and easy to perceive. Used for images, memories, colors, contrasts, and positions/stances.

examples.japanese: ⟦{記憶|きおく}→記憶：00234_kioku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{鮮明|せんめい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{残|のこ}っている→残る：01187_nokoru⟧。
{鮮明|せんめい}な⟦{画像|がぞう}→画像：13549_gazou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{撮影|さつえい}できる→撮影する：21990_satsueisuru⟧⟦カメラ→カメラ：04417_kamera⟧だ。
examples.english: It's a camera that can capture clear images.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{頃|ころ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{祖母|そぼ}→祖母：00813_sobo⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{過|す}ごした→過ごす：02062_sugosu⟧⟦{夏|なつ}→夏：02236_natsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日々|ひび}→日々：04804_hibi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{鮮明|せんめい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{思|おも}い{出|だ}される→思い出す：01258_omoidasu⟧。
examples.english: The summer days I spent with my grandmother as a child are still vividly remembered.

notes:
Often used with the adverbial form {鮮明|せんめい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ (vividly, clearly). Applies to both visual clarity and abstract clarity.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {鮮明|せんめい}な⟦{記憶|きおく}→記憶：00234_kioku⟧ (vivid memory)
- {鮮明|せんめい}な⟦{画像|がぞう}→画像：13549_gazou⟧ / ⟦{映像|えいぞう}→映像：04444_eizou⟧ (clear image / footage)
- {鮮明|せんめい}な⟦{色彩|しきさい}→色彩：13956_shikisai⟧ (vivid colors)
- {鮮明|せんめい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{覚|おぼ}えている→覚える：00739_oboeru⟧ (remember vividly)
- ⟦{態度|たいど}→態度：03396_taido⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{鮮明|せんめい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (make one's stance clear)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{明確|めいかく}→明確：01664_meikaku⟧ emphasizes logical or factual clarity
- {鮮明|せんめい} emphasizes perceptual vividness — sharp, bright, striking
- ⟦{鮮|あざ}やか→鮮やか：05702_azayaka⟧ also means vivid but focuses more on colors and visual beauty
